A_FIXED.scope: Fixed-layout elements, inline owned copies and caller-owned returns.

A_GROW.scope: Named local/global owners of supported fixed-layout elements, stable views, borrowed calls, independent by-value parameters, initialization, mutation, whole-owner assignment, named-result construction and adapted fixed/slice or mixed/multiple owned results into named receivers, forwarded returns and supported control expressions. Single-result anonymous calls/copies/literals/control values support scoped views, indexing, rendering, append and argument use. Discarded mixed/multiple-result calls materialize owned outputs after their arguments. Function-value ownership remains pending.

A_GROWSHRINK.scope: Named local/global owners of supported fixed-layout elements, stable views, borrowed calls, independent by-value parameters, initialization, mutation, whole-owner assignment, named-result construction and adapted fixed/slice or mixed/multiple owned results into named receivers, forwarded returns and supported control expressions. Single-result anonymous calls/copies/literals/control values support scoped views, indexing, rendering, append and argument use. Discarded mixed/multiple-result calls materialize owned outputs after their arguments. Function-value ownership remains pending.

A_LIMITED.scope: Resolved static capacity and runtime capacity with supported fixed-layout elements, mutation and owned results. Runtime values store in-region u32 capacity/length metadata and copies preserve the capacity extent; assignment preserves its pinned destination capacity after full RHS construction. Natural result channels preserve cross-kind conversion and named-result header aliases. Variable elements/containing values remain pending.

A_VAR.scope: Supported fixed-layout elements with default/u8/u16/u32/u64 length storage. In-region unsigned length prefixes with authoritative views; raw element-run forms remain distinct. Frozen owned values, width-checked local and parameter construction, normal/element-run results and forwarding, mixed receiving-width checks, inline retargeting, scoped views/indexing/loops and primitive rendering. Eager emitted forms use a conservative region bound. Varint lengths, variable elements and containing values remain pending.

fixed.scope: Fixed enum tags/payloads, constructors, copies, parameters/results and by-value matches; rendering/comparison are pending. Internal layout v3 packs fixed struct and variant fields, including recursive records and array strides; each field retains its current representation.

variant.scope: Fixed standalone variant payloads and variant-to-enum conversion; standalone SC_VARIABLE variants with fixed prefixes and one terminal variable/runtime-limited array, including nested nonframe record tails. Independent owned copies/parameters/results and whole-record NRVO; per-variant eligibility independent of siblings. Resizable standalone variants and nonfixed E.. payloads remain pending.

variable.scope: Nonresizable E.. with fixed payloads or one terminal variable/runtime-limited array through supported record chains. Independent region images, active-payload copies, owned ordinary/inline/recursive/control/mixed results, natural variant destination retargeting and pointer rebinding, copied/borrowed payload matches, tag-guarded cleanup and capacity/length checks. Tag-only named replacement preserves old payload references; nonempty alternatives observed by later results qualify for allfixed recursively packed fixed-width integer records, variants and nonempty fixed arrays; other such observations require further image layout and remain refused. Resizable/multiple-owner payloads, containing E.. owners and serialized images remain pending.

plain.scope: Supported fixed-layout plain references, including implicit parameter/address adaptation.

optional.scope: Null/identity/narrowing for supported fixed pointees; optional rendering is pending.

slice.scope: Packed wasm32 pointer/count views of fixed-layout elements.

relative.scope: Slot-relative offset loads/stores, widths and root validation pending.

pool_relative.scope: Pool identity, offset validation and pool lifetime lowering pending.

direct.scope: Concrete supported scalar/fixed-layout specialization and recursion, borrowed growable calls, by-value growable parameters and mixed/multiple owned growable result destinations with named-result construction. Forwarded fixed/slice/reference array results can construct growable receiving channels. Supported region-backed arrays and fixed-prefix single-tail variable structs use independent by-value parameters, natural result channels and named-result construction.

captured_environment.scope: Hidden captured binding addresses derived from final bodies, with transitive/recursive requirements, global initializer roots and function-value remapping. Scalars, mutable reference/slice bindings and supported owners share current-activation storage. Fixed and supported owned callback parameters/single results use independent copies, natural result contracts and scoped cleanup. Borrowed callback-local results and unsupported owned image targets remain gated; fixed nonlocal effects qualify the original full funval capture fixture at O0/O2.

overload_dispatch.scope: Checked enum case calls snapshot shared arguments once in source order. Fixed enum values and fixed variable-mode payloads copy in activation storage; nonfixed by-value variants receive one deep enum snapshot while reference cases retain original storage. Case-specific mapped captures and fixed/owned/multiple result destinations are shared. Ordinary arm calls preserve natural variable-array length checks. Fixed nonlocal effects propagate through selected arms. Unsupported layouts and unproved owned effect sources remain gated.

nonlocal_return.scope: Supported fixed results may accompany multiple Grow/GrowShrink or nested fixed-prefix Frame results. Every owned cursor snapshots before any source expression; independent private stages and fixed snapshots commit only after the attempt succeeds. Per-ordinal metadata preserves target entry cursors, physical suffixes, Frame base offsets, recursive activation identity and cross-frame cleanup. Exact-type tuples forward through closed ordinary producers without extra staging regions. Alias independence, cancellation, nested replacement, heterogeneous/generic results and region/activation exhaustion are qualified. Variable/capacity-limited and enum/non-frame-record owned image kinds remain gated.

layout.scope: Versioned migration from natural direct alignment to serializable C.2 images pending.

varints.scope: Bounded ULEB128 and zigzag storage and validation pending.

validation.scope: Framing, extent, tags and relative-link target verification pending.

output.scope: Synchronous write/numeric print/newline imports on V8 and Wasmtime.

input.scope: Benchmark scalar input adapters only; general standard-library IO pending.

numeric_intrinsics.scope: Exact supported sqrt/ceil/floor/trunc/fabs/clz signatures; remainder is pure Wasm.

filesystem.scope: General standard-library file and package host adapters pending.

threads_queues.scope: Independent instances, copied globals/arguments, canonical typed queues and lifecycle pending.

artifacts.scope: Complete-module cache with recorded source/config/probes; embedded/package-scan builds bypass reuse.

sessions.scope: Fresh request AST, persistent worker, per-request overlays.

closed_scalar_callers.scope: Closed acyclic canonical-i64 callers with parameter-only call arguments.

general_semantics.scope: Stable specialization/type/root/effect dependencies, broader checking and SCC reuse pending.

function_output.scope: Symbolic references, LEB-safe relocations and optimization/BCE dependencies pending.

adapted.scope: Seven bounded adapted cross-backend programs; does not qualify original growable/threaded programs.

original_small.scope: All 50 unadapted original task entrypoints including real threads pending.

original_production.scope: All 50 production cases with sufficient explicit runtime limits pending.

isolated_sieve.scope: Unchanged pinned Sieve computational kernel with isolated input/configuration harness; separate from the original 50-task entrypoint and bounded adapted ports.
